evidence_quote: Average points needed per game = Additional points needed / Total number of games
question_evidence_quote: His team has played 15 games this season. He has a goal of averaging 30 points per game for the entire 20 game season.
observed_error: The response divides the 210 additional points by all 20 season games instead of the 5 remaining games.
violated_condition: The additional points must be scored over the remaining 20 - 15 = 5 games.
error_description: The response calculates the required future scoring average by dividing 210 additional points by all 20 season games. Those points must be scored in the 5 games remaining after 15 have been played. The division is executed correctly, but its denominator violates the remaining-game requirement.
